audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer calls the third cast of Broken Wings an 'AoE stun' in four separate places (spikes[0].text, wants.foe[0], early, whys[1]).
audit.why: Riot's own text for Broken Wings is 'This ability can be reactivated three times in a short time frame with the third hit knocking back nearby enemies' — the kit flag is knockup, not hardCC/stun. Riven's only stun is Ki Burst (W). This is not a naming nitpick: a player told the third Q stuns will plan to eat it and then Wither, when in reality he is displaced and Ki Burst is still held. It also mis-sets expectations about how long he is actually locked down.
audit.corrected: Broken Wings' third cast knocks back. Ki Burst (W) is Riven's only stun.
sources: champ-data/_kits/riven.json (Q Broken Wings — knockup flag; W Ki Burst — hardCC flag)

audit.whatIsWrong: Three separate lines claim Wither stops Riven leaving or stops her dashes: spikes[1] 'her Q dashes and W stun can't kite you', mid 'no reposition, no kite', late 'a Riven who dashes in simply cannot leave — she's slowed to a crawl'.
audit.why: Valor and Broken Wings are dashes — fixed-distance movement that a move-speed slow does not shorten. Wither is a slow, not a root or a ground. A player who Withers a full-health Riven expecting her to be trapped gets out-traded when she simply Valors away. The real rule is a sequencing rule: Wither is only a lockdown once Valor has been spent.
audit.corrected: Wither does not shorten dashes. Hold it until Valor is spent; only then is a Withered Riven actually stuck.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flags 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere'. Neither layer states a single real cooldown, and breakdown.cooldowns lists Ki Burst twice.
audit.why: The decisive number in this lane is that Ki Burst is 11s at rank 1 falling to 7s, while Wither is 15s at rank 1 falling to 11s. Her stun always cycles faster than your answer, so trading them one-for-one is a losing exchange — you are naked for the gap. Valor at 10s at rank 1 is the other gate. None of this is stated anywhere.
audit.corrected: Ki Burst 11s>7s vs Wither 15s>11s — never trade them 1:1. Valor 10s at rank 1 is the window that makes Wither a real lockdown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing explains why Wither's attack-speed component matters against Riven specifically.
audit.why: Runic Blade is 'Riven's abilities charge her blade, and her basic attacks expend charges to deal an additional damage' — her ability casts only bank damage, her autos deliver it. Wither's attack-speed slow is therefore a direct cut to her damage output, not merely a kiting tool. The text currently treats the attack-speed slow as an anti-kite effect.
audit.corrected: Runic Blade charges are only cashed out by autos, so Wither's attack-speed slow cuts Riven's actual damage, not just her mobility.

audit.whatIsWrong: No mention that Riven's ultimate cooldown falls below Nasus's late.
audit.why: Blade of the Exile is 120/90/60 and Fury of the Sands is 120/100/80. At rank 3 she has hers back 20s sooner. The late-game text says the straight duel is 'unwinnable for her', which is true on stats but hides that she can pick the second fight with ult while you cannot.
audit.corrected: Blade of the Exile is 60s at rank 3 against Fury of the Sands' 80s — she gets hers back first.

audit.why: 54.61% over 542 games with the chart giving Riven the first two stages and Nasus the last three matches the kit reality — she has no percent-health and no true damage, so her scaling genuinely dies against a stacked Nasus. No change needed.

edits.before: Riven owns the first two levels — her three Q dashes, E shield-dash and the third-Q AoE stun let her burst you inside her window before you have any answer. Don't try to trade auto-for-auto here; soak Q last-hits, use Spirit Fire (E) to farm and chip from range, and accept you're behind on tempo. The whole early game is just hoarding stacks and not feeding her a kill — your lifesteal sustains the poke her combo can't fully convert without a stun-kill.
edits.after: Riven owns the first two levels — Broken Wings' three dashes, Valor's shield-dash and Ki Burst's stun burst you inside her window before you have any answer. Note the third Broken Wings cast knocks back, it does not stun: Ki Burst (W) is her only stun. Don't trade auto-for-auto here; soak Q last-hits, use Spirit Fire (E) to farm and chip from range, and accept you're behind on tempo. The early game is hoarding stacks and not feeding her a kill.

edits.before: Level 3 flips the kite war: Wither (W) is point-and-click, so the moment Riven dashes in you slam her movement speed AND attack speed and her entire combo unravels — no reposition, no kite, no clean stun follow-up. Through 4-5 it's a knife-fight you can now win if she over-commits, but respect that her burst still hurts if you eat the full Q-stun. At 6, Fury of the Sands plus a Wither-locked Riven is your power swing — ult mid-combo, let Spirit Fire shred her armor, and your bonus HP and lifesteal outlast her damage window.
edits.after: Wither (W) is point-and-click so it always lands, but spend it after Valor, not before — Valor is a fixed-distance dash and no move-speed slow shortens it. The attack-speed half is what actually hurts her, because Runic Blade charges are only cashed out by her autos. Count her stun too: Ki Burst is 11s at rank 1 against your 15s Wither, so she gets hers back first and you cannot trade them 1:1. At 6, ult mid-combo, let Spirit Fire shred her armor, and let lifesteal outlast the window.

notes: The 'third-cast AoE stun' error appears four times in the Riven content and is the same class of mistake as the calibration examples — Broken Wings' third cast is a knockback (kit flag: knockup); Ki Burst (W) is Riven's only stun. Worth grepping other owners' Riven entries for 'third-cast AoE stun' / 'third-Q AoE stun', since this reads like a generated phrase that was reused. Same for the 'Wither stops her dashes' claim — Wither is a pure slow and cannot shorten a fixed-distance dash; if that phrasing was templated across Nasus's dash-heavy matchups (Camille, Irelia, Fiora, Yasuo) it is wrong in all of them. As with Renekton, full phases[1] puts Wither online at Level 2 while content spikes[1] said Level 3; I rewrote the content line so it no longer makes an unlock claim rather than guessing the intended skill order.
